thread:
camille (sales): Hey team — Acme needs a short POC next week. Requesting an ephemeral Dedicated pool: 4 reserved GPUs, burst up to 10 GPUs for up to 2h/day during demo windows (Mar 30–Apr 1). Also need a rotated hosted API key scoped to the POC and an IP allowlist. Can eng/prod please confirm feasibility and a ballpark incremental cost? cc @maria (solutions)

maria (solutions): Thanks — quick Q: which model + typical seq length? helps sizing and expected token throughput. Also will Acme require VPC peering or just API keys?

camille (sales): Model: llama-13b-quant, typical seq ~1024 tokens, peak concurrent sessions ~60, demo traffic concentrated in two 1-hour windows each day. They want VPC peering for data-in-transit assurance but can test without it if it speeds setup.

diego (eng-infra): We can provision ephemeral pool and enable burst. Proposal: reserved=4, burst_max=10, burst_window=2h/day, autoscale cooldown 5m. Need an exact window schedule to avoid cross-customer spike. Also need RBAC for API key and note on cost impact.

nikhil (eng-runtime): For llama-13b-quant and 1024 seq, 4 reserved GPUs should cover baseline but burst to 10 for the two demo hours makes sense. Suggest enabling prefix KV caching and continuous batching to avoid token cost explosion. Also recommend soft-fallback policy to a cheaper variant if queue depth > 120s.

camille (sales): Window schedule: daily demos at 15:00-17:00 UTC Mar 30, 14:00-16:00 UTC Mar 31, 15:00-17:00 UTC Apr 1. They want public demo link for customers so low-latency windows are critical.

tara (security): For the API key rotation + VPC peering: security wants ephemeral keys with limited scope and 7-day TTL. If they insist on VPC peering, we'll need their network CIDR and an SLA for peering time. Also send the security questionnaire — we need responses before peering.

leo (finance): Ballpark incremental cost estimate: reserved 4 gpus for 3 days + burst usage ~ 36 GPU-hours reserved + up to 36 GPU-hours burst (depending on utilization). Rough estimate $X,XXX — I can give a tight quote once we know exact burst-hours and model perf. We also need approval for one-off demo credits if they exceed standard trial limits.

maria (solutions): To make setup reproducible, I'll propose an internal config and a CLI command. Camille, confirm you want me to proceed with provisioning. If yes, I'll ask infra to run create and security to issue an ephemeral key.

deploy-bot: scheduled action queued: open ticket INFRA-POC-4872 (owner: diego)

diego (eng-infra): Running plan. CLI we will use: 

```
rictl pool create \
  --name acme-poc-ephemeral \
  --reserved 4 \
  --burst-max 10 \
  --burst-hours-per-day 2 \
  --window "2026-03-30T15:00Z/2026-04-01T23:00Z" \
  --rbac "team:acme-poc" \
  --notes "sales POC - ephemeral; rotate keys; IP allowlist TBD"
```

Diego: I also need an approval comment from finance for potential overage credits.

leo (finance): Approving provisional up-to $2,500 in demo credits for overage risk. Will revisit after actual usage.

camille (sales): Approved — thanks Leo. Maria, proceed. Tara, I can get the network details by EOD if they insist on peering.

maria (solutions): On it. I'll open a short runbook for the POC with steps: pool create, key create (ephemeral, IP allowlist), add canary routing to cheaper model variant, monitoring dashboard.

tara (security): Share questionnaire here when done. If they want peering, we need the questionnaire answers plus a signed AUP. Without peering we can still provide the ephemeral key and strict host allowlist.

nikhil (eng-runtime): Two small recommendations before demo: 1) enable token-level cost tracing for the POC so we can shut burst quickly if cost spikes; 2) pin model version to avoid rollouts during demo.

camille (sales): Great — timeline: please provision by 2026-03-27 so we can run a dry-run. Anything else blocking?

diego (eng-infra): Nothing blocking from infra side once we have: final window schedule, IP allowlist (if not peering), and formal approval from finance (got it). I'll post ticket updates.

maria (solutions): I'll add the model pin, tracing, and canary route to the runbook. Camille — I'll ping you once infra confirms pool creation. :thumbsup:

camille (sales): Thanks all :rocket:
